title.home: Hijri and Gregorian dates for Angular Material

description.home: Hijri and Gregorian dates for Angular Material. A Hijri datepicker and date adapter for Angular Material, with form fields for the Umm al-Qura and Gregorian calendars.
description.getting-started: Install ngx-mat-hijri-adapter and register a Hijri or Gregorian datepicker in an Angular Material app.
description.calendar-values: CalendarDate values for the Gregorian and Umm al-Qura calendars, with helpers to create, convert, compare, and add.
description.date-adapter: HijriDateAdapter stores a CalendarDate. NativeHijriDateAdapter is the alternative when the stored value has to be a Date.
description.native-adapter: provideNativeHijriDateAdapter() is for a plain mat-datepicker that must store a Date. The ready-made fields do not use it.
description.parsing-formatting: Typed text is parsed in the adapter calendar, and each date is formatted in its own calendar.
description.form-fields: Ready-made date and date range fields for Angular Material, with a calendar toggle, an equivalent-date hint, and error messages.
description.styling: Style the date field and calendar popup with Material design tokens. This package adds no style input.
description.calendar-toggle: Replace the calendar toggle with your own template. The stored CalendarDate stays in valueCalendar.
description.reactive-fields: ReactiveDateField and ReactiveDateRangeField are ControlValueAccessors for formControl and formControlName.
description.signal-fields: SignalDateField and SignalDateRangeField implement FormValueControl for Angular signal forms.
description.right-to-left: Set layout direction with the CDK Dir directive. Direction, locale, and calendar are independent.
description.api: Public exports of ngx-mat-hijri-adapter, the native adapter, and the reactive and signal fields.
description.gotchas: Gregorian calendar identifiers, CalendarDate toString, and other details that surprise people the first time.
description.ai-agents: A skill shipped with the package so a coding agent can use the adapter correctly.
description.roadmap: What ships in ngx-mat-hijri-adapter today, what is in progress, and what is only an idea.

nativeAdapter.instant: 1 Ramadan 1445 is stored as the Gregorian instant 2024-03-11T12:00:00.000Z.
nativeAdapter.fields: The ready-made fields store a CalendarDate so the toggle can change the calendar on screen while valueCalendar stays the saved value. A Gregorian field can show 1/9/1445 and still hold Gregorian 2024-03-11. A Date cannot do that, because it has no calendar to keep. The fields also add the hint. They do not use this provider.

nativeAdapter.noCalendar: A Date has no calendar, so valueCalendar does not apply. There is no toggle on this path. A toggle here would only change the text on screen.
nativeAdapter.calendarOf: calendarOf() does not apply. One Date is both 1 Ramadan 1445 and 11 March 2024.
nativeAdapter.intlNames: Hijri month names come from Intl and can differ between browsers.
nativeAdapter.math: Hijri day math uses this package's Umm al-Qura table, limited to AH 1300–1599.
nativeAdapter.json: JSON.stringify writes the Gregorian instant, not 1445-09-01.
nativeAdapter.peer: Loading ngx-mat-hijri-adapter/native still loads the main entry, so @internationalized/date stays installed.

stylingPage.lead: The ready-made fields inherit the project's Material system tokens and any global design tokens. This package adds no style input and does not override those tokens.
stylingPage.packageBody: The field fills its container. The pressed calendar-toggle button uses --mat-sys-primary and --mat-sys-secondary-container. Those are the only colors this package sets.
stylingPage.appBody: The calendar popup is an overlay, so its tokens belong on html. That includes the toggle icon, which uses the datepicker color rather than the form-field icon color. This page sets them while it is open. Datepicker token names are on the
stylingPage.localBody: The sample uses both mixins. mat.form-field-overrides() on the form changes the input. mat.datepicker-overrides() on html changes the toggle icon and the calendar popup, because the popup is an overlay. Form-field token names are on the
stylingPage.demoText: The form sets the shape and outline. The toggle icon and the popup use the datepicker tokens on html: a tertiary icon, a tertiary-tinted background, and a tertiary selected day. The field still stores the same CalendarDate.

calendarTogglePage.lead: A #calendarToggle template replaces the whole toggle. The stored CalendarDate stays in valueCalendar.
calendarTogglePage.whyBody: The ready-made fields store a CalendarDate, which keeps its own calendar. The toggle changes only the calendar on screen, so a Gregorian field can show 1/9/1445 and still hold Gregorian 2024-03-11. The control is not marked dirty.
calendarTogglePage.templateBody: Put one ng-template with the reference #calendarToggle inside the field. let-controller receives display, valueCalendar, labels, disabled, show, and open. show switches the calendar and leaves the picker closed. open switches it and opens the picker. The calendarToggle attribute is optional next to this template. equivalentHint still shows under the field.
calendarTogglePage.demoText: The icon shows the calendar on screen and opens a menu. Choosing a calendar calls controller.open. The line under the field is the stored value, which stays Gregorian.

twoCalendars.title: Two calendars, one adapter
twoCalendars.detail: HijriDateAdapter runs the Umm al-Qura or Gregorian calendar and can switch at runtime.

locale.title: Locale is not the calendar
locale.detail: An English Hijri picker and an Arabic Gregorian picker both work. Locale sets digits, names, and the week start.

calendarDate.title: CalendarDate values
calendarDate.detail: HijriDateAdapter stores CalendarDate objects from @internationalized/date, so a time zone cannot shift the day.

native.title: Native Hijri adapter
native.detail: provideNativeHijriDateAdapter() from ngx-mat-hijri-adapter/native is an alternative for a plain mat-datepicker. It stores a JavaScript Date at UTC noon. Intl formats and parses it. The ready-made fields store CalendarDate and do not use this provider.

datepicker.title: Material datepicker
datepicker.detail: A plain mat-datepicker uses the adapter, including min, max, and date filters.

fields.title: Reactive and signal fields
fields.detail: Date and range fields for reactive forms and for signal forms.

toggle.title: Calendar toggle
toggle.detail: The field can show and accept the other calendar while the stored value stays in valueCalendar. An optional hint shows that same day in the other calendar.

formats.title: Display formats
formats.detail: Numeric day, month, and year, or the locale's month name.

parsing.title: Strict parsing
parsing.detail: Typed text is read in the active calendar, including Arabic-Indic and Persian digits. Unreadable text becomes an invalid date instead of a guessed one.

rtl.title: Right-to-left
rtl.detail: Works with the CDK direction directive, including the datepicker overlay.

ngAdd.title: ng add
ngAdd.detail: ng add installs the calendar peer when it is missing and registers provideHijriDateAdapter().

agents.title: Agent skill
agents.detail: The package ships a markdown skill any coding agent can follow to install the adapter and store dates.

docsI18n.title: Arabic and English docs
docsI18n.detail: The docs site switches between English and Arabic with ngx-translate. Arabic uses the Noto Kufi Arabic font and a right-to-left layout.

calendarOf.title: calendarOf() helper
calendarOf.detail: Application code can ask which supported calendar a CalendarDate uses, without comparing gregory and gregorian by hand.

toggleTemplates.title: Custom calendar-toggle templates
toggleTemplates.detail: A #calendarToggle template replaces the icon buttons. let-controller can show or open either calendar while valueCalendar stays the saved value.
